Name: Kenneth's Birthday Treat
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]It's my birthday bash![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Summer 20 in-game is a very special day - it's my birthday! Let's party![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]As a thank you for supporting my mods, I'm treating YOU to some birthday goodies every year.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2x Chests, Light String, 10x Pink Cakes, 10x Chocolate Cakes, 10x Cookies, Mixed Seeds, 3x Golden Mystery Boxes, Diamonds, Iridium Sprinklers, Warp Totems, Stardrop Tea, Starfruit and 15,000g.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Mail arrives every Summer 20 (Yearly)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Lore-friendly, not OP[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 1.6 compatible[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - only Content Patcher, no extra dependencies, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- One version, just install and enjoy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Thanks for celebrating with me![/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Birthday Boy Kenneth[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my yearly mail gift mods are on separate mod pages but they work perfectly together with no conflicts and no overwrites. You can install just one or all of them if you want to experience celebrations throughout the whole year - your choice! [/b][/size][b][size=4]Full list:[/size][/b]
